plugins.name: gitlab-duo-setup
plugins.description: Turns on GitLab Duo Code Review and Fix CI/CD Pipeline for your group, connects the GitLab MCP server, and follows your merge requests through review and pipeline fixes. Works on GitLab.com, Self-Managed and Dedicated.
